# MorningQuote

> Create personalized good morning quote cards in seconds. 100% free client-side card generator with custom names, sunrise aesthetics, and instant HD downloads for WhatsApp and Instagram.

## Overview
MorningQuote (https://morning-quote.com/) is a lightweight, privacy-first web application for generating aesthetic morning greeting cards and browsing curated daily inspirational quotes.

## Core Capabilities
- **Aesthetic Greeting Card Generator**: Real-time rendering via HTML5 Canvas with zero server-side processing.
- **Multi-Format Support**: Instant toggle between 1:1 Square (1080x1080) for Instagram posts/WhatsApp chats and 9:16 Story (1080x1920) for WhatsApp Status and Reels.
- **Curated Quote Library**: 50+ handpicked quotes categorized into Inspirational, Love & Romance, For Friends, Monday Motivation, Blessings & Peace, and Short & Sweet.
- **Public Domain Citations**: Quotes attributed to verified historical authors (Marcus Aurelius, William Arthur Ward, Ralph Waldo Emerson, Henry David Thoreau, Rumi, Khalil Gibran).
- **Zero Privacy Footprint**: All personalization, recipient names, and custom messages are processed locally on the user's device.

## Authorship & Attribution
MorningQuote is curated and maintained by the MorningQuote Editorial Team. Literary quotes are selected from public domain works and verified philosophical writings.
